page.title: Facials
page.intro: Five facials, each started by looking at your skin under a lamp, by the window.

sections.heading: Before you come
sections.text: Come without make-up if you can. If you use retinol or acids, stop them two days before a peel.

sections.heading: Choosing
sections.text: Not sure? Tell us how your skin feels on WhatsApp, or choose on the day: your facialist may suggest something else once she has seen your skin.

items.name: Hydrating facial
items.line: Cleanse, a gentle enzyme, a long massage and a mask for skin that feels tight.
items.afterwards: You may look a little pink for up to an hour.
items.evening: Skip retinol and acids tonight. Your usual moisturiser, and SPF in the morning.

reminders.label: SPF this morning, and every morning this week

items.name: Long facial

items.afterwards: Nothing to hide. Most people go home and sleep well.
items.evening: Leave the oil on and wash your face in the morning.

reminders.label: Wash off last night's oil this morning

items.name: Light peel

items.afterwards: Light flaking for two to four days.

firstVisit.title: Your first visit
firstVisit.intro: What happens, and when to come in for a patch test.

sections.heading: Arriving
sections.text: Come five minutes early. We give you a short form about your skin and anything you use on it.

sections.heading: Before we start
sections.text: Your facialist looks at your skin under a lamp and asks how it has been. She may suggest a different facial from the one you booked; the choice is yours.

sections.heading: Afterwards
sections.text: We write down what we used and what to do tonight, and send it to you on WhatsApp.

sections.heading: Under 18
sections.text: We do not offer peels to anyone under 18. For other treatments, under-16s come with a parent.

sections.heading: Changing your appointment
sections.text: Tell us 24 hours before and there is no charge.

patch.line: Tints, lash lifts, peels and any product new to you need a patch test 48 hours before. It takes five minutes and is free.

courses.title: Courses and memberships
courses.intro: For skin you want to look after through the year.
courses.note: Courses are valid for six months from the first treatment and are not refundable once started.

courses.line: Four light peels a month apart, with the patch test before the first.

questions.a: Choose by how your skin feels on the home page, or book the hydrating facial. Your facialist looks at your skin first and may suggest something else.

questions.q: Do I need a patch test?
questions.a: For tints, lash lifts, peels and any product new to you: yes, 48 hours before. It takes five minutes and is free.
After most facials we'd rather you didn't until the next morning. Each card says what to do that evening.
Tell us 24 hours before and there is no charge.
Yes. Many of our clients are men; the men's facial works around a beard.

questions.q: I'm pregnant. Can I still come?
questions.a: Tell us when you book. We change some products and skip peels, and massage is on your side.
No. We are facialists. For anything a doctor or nurse would prescribe, ask your GP.

questions.q: Can I buy a gift for someone?
questions.a: Yes, on the gifts page. We write the card by hand and post it, or email it the same day.
